Alyssa H: Heads up — Q2 inbound dashboard shows ~15% drop in MQLs week-over-week. SFDC lead count doesn't match the dashboard totals. anyone else noticing? :thinking:
Mike L: Hmm, saw something similar in the webinar funnel. could be a mapping issue from the registration feed to GA/Looker.
Rachel P: Which dashboard? the 'Inbound > MQLs' or the 'Channel Performance' one? Filters often default to campaign_stage=trial which hides webinar-sourced leads.
Alyssa H: Inbound > MQLs (weekly KPIs). I pulled the last 6 weeks. dashboard vs SFDC for last week: dashboard=1,420, SFDC=1,710.
Ben Q: that's a 20% delta. can you paste the CSV? also which attribution model are we using here? last-touch GA?
Alyssa H: attaching quick snippet below (copied):
```
week, dashboard_mqls, sfdc_mqls
2026-03-09, 1710, 1710
2026-03-16, 1420, 1710
```
Mike L: looks like week boundary/UTC vs PST weirdness has bitten us before. also webinar registration imports sometimes land as source=organic if UTM params dropped.
Rachel P: can we run a join on event_imports -> registrations -> sfdc to see which leads are missing UTM_source? rough SQL: 
```
SELECT r.id, r.created_at, r.utm_source, s.status
FROM registrations r
LEFT JOIN sfdc_leads s ON s.email = r.email
WHERE r.created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-16'
AND (r.utm_source IS NULL OR r.utm_source = '')
LIMIT 200;
```
Analytics Bot: weekly_kpi_export.csv generated (s3://redwood-exports/weekly_kpi/1801234567.csv) — 2.4MB. run_id=wk-2026-03-16-01
Ben Q: I'll run Rachel's query now and surface rows missing utm_source. if webinar imports are the issue we can patch the ingestion to preserve utm params.
Mike L: also check the inbound routing rule that maps 'source=webinar' -> campaign=event_webinar_x. Recent change to the routing regex might have broken it.
Alyssa H: Good plan. Action items: 1) Ben runs the join + posts top 20 missing utm examples (Ben) 2) Mike checks routing regex + history (Mike) 3) Rachel to validate dashboard filter logic and Looker PDT refresh (Rachel) — Can we aim to have findings before tomorrow's KPI review? :calendar:
Ben Q: on it, will post results in this thread in ~30m.
Rachel P: pinging @analytics for PDT refresh after Ben's query so numbers recompute.
Mike L: if we find a mapping bug I'll roll a hotfix and notify sales ops.
Alyssa H: thanks team — if we can't reconcile we should show both numbers in the KPI slide (dashboard vs SFDC) and call out attribution caveat. prefer we fix before slides but have fallback. :+1:
Analytics Bot: note: next automated KPI run scheduled 2026-03-17T04:00:00Z.
